_meta.note: Synthesized from the adapter's own source, not captured: claude-agent-acp 0.107.0 (the v1 core). The Fast mode option: dist/session-fast-mode.js:69-89 (createFastModeConfigOption), the on/off select a client sent that declares no clientCapabilities.session.configOptions.boolean (dist/session-config-options.js:58-60, clientSupportsBooleanConfigOptions), as Crew declares none; dist/session-config-options.js:67-82 (buildConfigOptions) lists it only while the model supportsFastMode, after the mode select (dist/session-mode.js:95-110). The write: session/set_config_option fast=on answered with the session's configOptions, dist/v1/acp-agent.js:5733-5745 through dist/v1/acp-agent.js:7145-7150 (applyFastMode). The SDK turning it off: a user turn's result carrying fast_mode_state off and fast_mode_disabled_reason free, dist/v1/acp-agent.js:3837-3842, reconciled by dist/v1/acp-agent.js:7174-7197 (syncFastModeState) into the notice of dist/session-fast-mode.js:128-152 (fastModeStateChange; the reason text from dist/session-fast-mode.js:25-34) sent as a notice update (dist/session-notices.js:11-18) because Crew declares clientCapabilities.session.notices, then a config_option_update whose fast option reads off with the reason in its description. No model option: the frames carry no model id.
